mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which historically correlates with increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a weakening supply chain, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 8% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decrease by more than 100,000 in the same month, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS MoM < -100,000 and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% YoY and real final sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 2% YoY, it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST YoY > 10% and RSAFS YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25 basis points in a month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS MoM < -0.25% and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 2% YoY, it signals a recessionary supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ < 0 for 2 quarters AND INDPRO YoY < -2%
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ < 0 for 2 quarters and INDPRO YoY < -2% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
